name: justinpriday.containers
description: Worktree-bound container controls for Docker Engine and Docker Compose in Daintree.

scripts.build: node tools/clean-dist.mjs && vite build && node tools/check-panel-bundle.mjs && vite build --config vite.config.worker.ts && node tools/minify-worker.mjs
scripts.package: npm run licenses && npm run build && node tools/package.mjs
scripts.release:prepare: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run package && npm run validate
scripts.stage:install: npm run licenses:check && npm run build && node tools/stage-install-dir.mjs
